issue_context.title: wifi interface statistics (/proc/net/wireless )
issue_context.body:
##### Feature idea summary

`/proc/net/wireless` contains some useful info about wifi interfaces

```
[ilyam@ilyam-pc ~]$ cat /proc/net/wireless 
Inter-| sta-|   Quality        |   Discarded packets               | Missed | WE
 face | tus | link level noise |  nwid  crypt   frag  retry   misc | beacon | 22
wlp5s0: 0000   68.  -42.  -256        0      0      0      0   3851        0

```

related link: [link](https://unix.stackexchange.com/questions/407775/how-is-proc-net-wireless-a-clone-of-proc-net-dev), [structiw__statistics](http://docs.ros.org/jade/api/heatmap/html/structiw__statistics.html)

##### Expected behavior

collect wifi statistics from `/proc/net/wireless`

review_comments: It would be good to add the module description and configuration to the [documentation](https://github.com/netdata/netdata/blob/master/collectors/proc.plugin/README.md).
It was added yesterday to the PR.

You have to use `netdata_configured_host_prefix` like it is used in https://github.com/netdata/netdata/blob/master/collectors/proc.plugin/proc_meminfo.c#L123. It is needed for monitoring a host from a containerized Netdata.
I already fixed this with new PR.
